name: Tamil Nadu Highways Department
summary: The state department that builds and maintains Tamil Nadu's state highways, major district roads and bridges.
about: Tamil Nadu is one of the few states with a Highways Department separate from its Public Works Department, and it looks after one of the densest state road networks in India. It maintains the state highways and major district roads that connect Tamil Nadu's unusually large number of medium-sized cities, and it also builds most of the bypasses and grade separators around them.
facts: Responsible for Tamil Nadu's state highways and major district roads.
Also looks after most state-owned bridges and government buildings.
National highways in the state are not its responsibility — those belong to NHAI, NHIDCL or the state's national highway wing.
